purpose: Perform receipt-bound, label-free speech-feature preprocessing for the exact fresh 104-row SELECT/FILL discovery roster. The launcher constructs samples only from receipt-pinned sample identifiers and media facts; it never loads task text, gold, reference transcripts, annotations, outputs, scores, test data, or future turns. A current-build CPU-only llama sidecar on port 8081 uses the fixed minimal one-token preprocessing prompt and legacy feature cache. After the sidecar stops, the carrier-neutral promotion primitive writes audited packets into the exclusive SELECT/FILL packet root. Identity and preflight modes make no model, network, tokenizer, scorer, or audio-decoding contact. This fragment grants no run or exposure authority.

a2t_semantic_agentloop_select_fill_prepr.promotion_path: core.model.speech_features.materialize_legacy_cached_speech_feature_packets, called directly after the CPU-only encoder session stops; the carrier-specific SLURP command is not used

a2t_semantic_agentloop_select_fill_prepr.identity_inputs: receipt metadata, additive D1 media receipt, and config fragments only
a2t_semantic_agentloop_select_fill_prepr.preflight_inputs: receipt metadata plus filesystem path, size, SHA-256, and WAV container-header validation; speech content is not decoded or interpreted
a2t_semantic_agentloop_select_fill_prepr.gpu_decoder: not started, stopped, reconfigured, or contacted
a2t_semantic_agentloop_select_fill_prepr.authority: none; running requires a separately valid exposure registration and execution plan
